profile.ja: 水城ゆきかぜの母親。最強の対魔忍・井河アサギの右腕として五車黎明期を支え、“幻影不知火”と呼ばれる武勇智謀に長けた対魔忍であった。現在は淫魔族のもとで先代の王から力を引き継ぎ、魔界を支配する９つの有力貴族の一角“幻夢卿”となった。不知火はアミダハラにある魔界の門を通って人間界を訪れると、時に正体を隠し、時に自身の地位を誇示しながら複数の組織の有力者と社交の場で駆け引きをしていく。その場では、不知火の豊満な肉体と美貌も大きな武器となっている。
profile.en: She is Mizuki Yukikaze's mother. As the right hand of the strongest Taimanin, Igawa Asagi, she supported the dawn of Gosha and was known as the "Phantom Shiranui" for her martial prowess and cunning. Now she inherited power from the previous demon king under the succubus race, becoming one of the nine powerful nobles that rule the Demon Realm, the "Kamadeva." When Shiranui passes through the Demon Realm gate in Amida-hara to the Human Realm, she sometimes hides her identity, sometimes flaunts her status, bargaining with influential figures from multiple organizations. In those settings, Shiranui's voluptuous body and beauty are also great weapons.
